title: Overlapping Times in basal Tab leading to wrong iob? Dev-i
symptom: Temporary basal rates are not cancelled and their times overlap in the basal tab, potentially leading to wrong IOB calculations. The issue is reported with the Omnipod DASH pump.
cause: Testing in the thread indicates the overlapping TBRs occur when Nightscout sync is enabled: with NSClient paused, overlap did not reproduce for extended periods, and it returned after unpausing NSClient. MilosKozak observed that AAPS appears to be updating old records, pointing to Nightscout-sync-triggered updates of old temporary basal records as the likely cause.
fix: The thread states the issue is hopefully fixed by PR #1715. During investigation, pausing NSClient / disabling Nightscout sync was used as the effective workaround.
evidence_quote: hopefully fixed by #1715 open new issue if the problem persists
